effects.before: iterated directly over event_data["tags"] to build tags[<key>] attributes; this raised a KeyError if event_data had no "tags" key, and would raise a TypeError if event_data["tags"] was None (attempting to iterate None)
effects.after: reads tags via event_data.get("tags") and only runs the tag-encoding loop when tags is not None; if the "tags" key is absent or its value is None, no tags[<key>] attributes are added and the function proceeds without error, still emitting attributes["tag_keys"] (as an empty array in that case)

suppression_flags.swallows: the KeyError previously raised when "tags" was absent from event_data, and the TypeError previously raised when event_data["tags"] was None, are no longer raised; a missing or null tags field is now silently treated as "zero tags" instead of surfacing as an exception
